description: Numeric constants of the estimator and the simulator, shared by the Python package (module constants of python/src/fftvel/core.py) and the MATLAB/Octave package (matlab/+fftvel/+internal/constants.m). tests/python/test_constants.py and tests/matlab/test_constants.m check that both implementations hold exactly these names and values. Change a value in all three places at once and regenerate the parity cases (tests/parity/make_cases.py).

DEFAULT_L.meaning: Default L: half the number of exposures, K = 2L+1 = 9.

DEFAULT_PAD_FACTOR.meaning: Default zero padding factor of the FFT: npad = pad_factor * n.

DEFAULT_MIN_QUALITY.meaning: Default lowest fit quality accepted for valid (min_quality / MinQuality).

MIN_SIZE.meaning: Smallest side of the analysed square, and smallest roi, in px.

MIN_EXPOSURES.meaning: Smallest number of exposures K accepted by the exposures option.

LOG_FLOOR.meaning: Floor of the log spectrum as a fraction of the median of |B|: S = log(|B| + LOG_FLOOR*median|B|); the mean of |B| replaces the median if the median is 0. Keeps S independent of the image scale.

BLANK_FLOOR.meaning: Floor used instead when |B| is 0 everywhere (blank image); the estimate then comes out not valid.

CLIP_SIGMA.meaning: clip_outliers: pixels more than CLIP_SIGMA robust standard deviations from the median are set to the median.

MAD_SCALE.meaning: Robust standard deviation = MAD_SCALE * median absolute deviation (1.4826 for normal noise).

CLIP_RADIUS.meaning: clip_outliers: the pixels within CLIP_RADIUS px (dy^2 + dx^2 <= CLIP_RADIUS^2) of a clipped pixel are set to the median as well, so that the faint rim of a glint goes with its core.

ANGLE_STEP.meaning: Step of the angle grid in degrees: 0, ANGLE_STEP, ..., 180 - ANGLE_STEP (0..179). The maximum of WR is refined by a parabola through three neighbouring angles (periodic); the speed maximum likewise on the speed grid.

RFRAC.meaning: Fraction of the spectrum radius rmax = npad/2 - 1 used for the ripple profile WR and for the speed fit.

WEIGHT_FLOOR.meaning: Lower bound of the bin weights in the mean projection, so empty bins do not divide by 0.

PROFILE_START.meaning: First bin of the half profile used for the speed fit (bins 0 and 1 hold the peak at zero frequency).

SPEED_STEP.meaning: Step of the logarithmic speed grid: v(k+1)/v(k) = exp(SPEED_STEP).

VMIN_FACTOR.meaning: Lower end of the measurable range: vmin = VMIN_FACTOR*npad/(K*max(jpos)), where the first spectral zero still lies well inside the profile.

MIN_LINE_SPACING.meaning: Upper end of the measurable range: vmax = npad/MIN_LINE_SPACING, where the motion lines are this many bins apart.

GUARD_FACTOR.meaning: The speed grid extends down to vmin/GUARD_FACTOR as a guard band; a best speed there gives in_range = false.

TREND_DEGREE.meaning: Degree of the polynomial in jpos that absorbs the smooth texture spectrum before the correlation (cubic).

TEMPLATE_FLOOR.meaning: The Dirichlet and box templates are 0.5*log(P + TEMPLATE_FLOOR).

FLAT_MODEL.meaning: Speeds (or blur lengths) whose detrended template has a norm below FLAT_MODEL times the norm of the template score 0 (flat model, no information).

NULL_K.meaning: Null quality tanh(NULL_K/sqrt(m - NULL_OFFSET)): the largest quality was tanh(8.41/sqrt(m-5)) on the 1008 calibration images without motion and tanh(8.64/sqrt(m-5)) on all 2268 simulated images without motion (experiments/calibrate_threshold.py); none of them is valid with 9.

NULL_OFFSET.meaning: Points taken from the m independent profile points: TREND_DEGREE + 1 by the polynomial and 1 by the fit; the threshold is infinite for m <= NULL_OFFSET.

INDEPENDENT_PAD.meaning: Independent profile points m = min(points, floor(INDEPENDENT_PAD*n*points/npad)): padding beyond this factor only interpolates and does not lower the threshold.

ISO_GAP.meaning: Isotropy check: isotropic if quality - quality_perp < ISO_GAP and ...

ISO_LOG_SPEED.meaning: ... |log(speed_perp/speed)| < ISO_LOG_SPEED (defocus blur or a square repeating texture, not motion).

BLUR_STEP.meaning: Blur check: the continuous blur of box_template is sampled every BLUR_STEP px (for a blur of K*BLUR_STEP px it equals the Dirichlet template of K exposures BLUR_STEP apart).

BLUR_GAP.meaning: Blur check: blur_like if quality - quality_blur < BLUR_GAP (0: one continuous exposure, motion blur without flashes, fits better than the K flashes) and the speed is below npad/max(profile_j), where the repeated lines of the flashes lie beyond the fitted profile.

SAT_SHARE.meaning: saturated: the share of pixels at the maximum counts only when it is at least SAT_SHARE, unless the maximum is the largest value of an integer type (then any share counts).

SAT_WARN.meaning: Front ends (command line, stream, matlab/examples/live_basler.m, experiments/real_measurements.py) warn when saturated exceeds SAT_WARN.

SIM_MARGIN.meaning: Simulator: the texture is at least n + (K-1+duty)*max|v| + SIM_MARGIN px in both directions.

DEFAULT_CORR_LEN.meaning: Simulator: default correlation length of the random texture in px.

GREY_WEIGHTS.meaning: R, G, B weights of the conversion of colour images to grey (those of MATLAB rgb2gray).
